data.one_liner: Utility library for common geospatial calculations in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides static methods to compute distances, bearings, midpoints, destinations, intersections, proximity, boundaries, area, clustering and heatmap generation for LatLng points.
use_when: You need quick geospatial math without external services
You want a lightweight, pure Dart solution for map calculations
You need clustering or heatmap generation for a set of points
avoid_when: You require real-time GPS tracking or map rendering
You need integration with Google Maps or other map SDKs
You need advanced geofencing or location services beyond basic math
strengths: All methods are static, easy to call
Supports multiple clustering algorithms and heatmap generation
weaknesses: No map rendering or location services
Limited to calculations, not UI widgets
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: latlong2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides LatLng class and basic distance calculations but lacks clustering and heatmap features
